'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Mike Richards LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)]]
* '''Username:''' mr007agent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
